answer: A seat persists only while a stranger keeps it. Each epoch an identity needs renewal by a custodian that did not introduce it and shares no attestors; one custodian may renew at most three, and may refuse. The custodian's standing is pledged behind every seat it renews, so a seat that later defects spends its custodian's balance first. A farm of n names therefore needs n over three fresh independent custodians each epoch, each willing to carry a stranger's risk, which no operator can conjure on the mesa. One honest newcomer on the ferrous book needs one renewer, not a ridge of them.
